text: Oh, absolutely. I use a toothbrush. You know, the one with bristles and toothpaste, not the "shaking a plastic dumbbell" method that the fitness industry is so desperately trying to convince us is a substitute for basic hygiene. Because nothing says "dental health" like hoping that if I just flick my wrist hard enough, my enamel will magically polish itself into submission. It’s truly the epitome of effortlessness: why brush for two minutes when you can just pretend you’re working out your jawline?
